# npm: vanilla-cookieconsent@3.1.0  (NOT the `cookieconsent` package: that name
#       still points at the 2.x line, whose API has no `acceptedCategory`,
#       `onFirstConsent` or opt-in `categories`. Fetching "3.1.1" from that name
#       yields a 2.x bundle that silently never fires our callbacks — verified
#       and corrected 2026-09-15.)
